name: Joule Capital Partners Utah campus gas interconnection to Kern River
researcher_notes: Joule Capital Partners applied to Millard County, Utah, for a development agreement to build a 24-inch natural gas transmission pipeline from the Holden area to the McCornick area. The county planning commission notice is for a hearing on May 7, 2026. The notice does not name the data center or Kern River. Holden is where Kern River's mainline runs near the Delta Lateral tap. A Cleanview profile of the Joule data center campus from January 2026 says the campus will connect to the Kern River mainline through redundant 36-inch interconnections, so the tie to the campus comes from that profile and the applicant being the campus developer. The county notice says 24-inch and the profile says 36-inch, so it is not certain these are the same line. Length was not found and no route was found. Status is proposed because no approval or construction was found. Operator not found. Owner name not in the owner list. Separate from the Kern River Delta Lateral (P3856).
